snippet.title: Thunder Edge - SAGExpo 2025 Teaser
snippet.description:
Check out Thunder Edge at SAGExpo 2025 this year when the demo drops on September 19, 2025!

https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/thunder-edge.2698/

Check out development updates on the Sapphire Flame Games Bluesky account: https://bsky.app/profile/sapphirefla.me

Thunder Edge is made by Sapphire Flame Games, an indie dev studio primarily ran by DrgnBeauty; all music, assets, etc belong to SFG. Promo and key art done by Robin Zeigler.

#ThunderEdge #megaman #sonic #indiedev #gamedev #gamemaker
